label: Shopping
tooltip: When silver or gold hits a threshold, pause other automation and let Knightshopper buy your Occult Crescent list. Needs Knightshopper (see Dependencies). Never starts during a FATE or CE.

enable_auto_shop.label: Enable auto-shop
enable_auto_shop.tooltip:
On: when silver or gold is at its threshold (and you are not in a FATE or CE), pause other automation and start Knightshopper’s Occult Crescent shopping list. Configure items in Knightshopper. Can interrupt treasure hunting and idle Mob Farmer waits; not mid-pull or mid-fight. Does nothing if Knightshopper is missing or not ready.
Off: never auto-shop.

silver_threshold.label: Silver threshold
silver_threshold.tooltip: Start shopping when silver pieces (South Horn) or silver obols (North Horn) reach this. Never during a FATE or CE, or mid Mob Farmer pull/fight. 0 = never start from silver.

gold_threshold.label: Gold threshold
gold_threshold.tooltip: Start shopping when gold pieces (South Horn) or gold obols (North Horn) reach this. Never during a FATE or CE, or mid Mob Farmer pull/fight. 0 = never start from gold.
